title: My Half-Brother Stole My $102K Carousel And Sent Me A $4,500 Cut. So I Made Him Work It Off.
description: Nancy poured a $102,000 widow's inheritance into restoring a 1920s carousel with her half-brother, only to receive a $4,500 check after he secretly sold it for $750,000. She found their original notarized agreement hidden in a carved horse and voided the sale. Now he buffs brass poles in a fraud vest at her 'Carousel of Lies.' #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #TrueStory
thumb_text: HE SOLD MY CAROUSEL, NOW HE WEARS A FRAUD VEST
pinned_comment: What would you do if your half-brother stole your $102,000 carousel and mailed you a $4,500 'fair share' check? Have you ever uncovered hidden proof to take back what was yours? Share your story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: FOUND ORIGINAL AGREEMENT IN A CARVED HORSE AND VOIDED THE SALE
